Registered CCP-A: $K$ = 1000, both cohort terms, mean, mirror views. $K$ = all: mean over the whole bank; class means: the bank replaced by base-class means, with the fraction of nearest means matched to $K$ or with all means; query only / prototype only: $c_k-m_K(q)$ / $c_k-m_K(p_k)$, each with coefficient 1; CCP-S: mean and standard deviation; single view: no mirror views for queries, prototypes, and bank.\par
(b) AUROC gains in points over the reference (CCP-A on frozen hosts, $H_{\mathrm{fix}}$ on trained hosts), averaged over the eight configurations of the variants round (the four trained-host configurations for the fusion-weight factor); min.: lowest configuration gain. Criteria (i)--(iv) as in \cref{sec:ablations}. Test difference: range of the paired test differences from the reference over the same configurations, from a single test pass of all four variants.\par
